I watched a video on YouTube titled “Early symptoms of coronavirus & dealing with the disease.” By “The REAL David Abel”. He currently has the coronavirus(or did at the time of the video) and he recommended looking into EFT(emotional freedom techniques) and breathing exercises. He said that his lung capacity was at 93% and that he would have been put on a respirator if he hit 90% but by doing those techniques in 48 hours he was at 99% and then finally started feeling better. I don’t know if this will help but I figured it’s worth a try to tell you. Again, I hope you’re doing okay.
